title: dumpcap: ifdef out more functions not used by Windows
description:
cap_pipe_read and cap_pipe_select are not used by Windows
after removing the socket support. cap_thread_read is
currently ifdef'd to only exist on _WIN32 but has some
internal ifdefs for the non _WIN32 case anyway.

Reorganize to decrease the number of ifdefs and avoid
defining static functions on Windows that aren't used.
Fix the MSYS2 and other cross-compiling builds.

AI-Assisted: no
